question: In which running event in athletics are hurdles used?
solution:
The correct answer is __**400 meters Race**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Hurdles are used in the 110-meter and **400-meter races in the sport of athletic**s.
 
• Both races are **Olympic events**
 
• **400-meter hurdles**
 
 
• This race is open to both men and women.
 
• The hurdles are 9**1.4 cm high for men and 76.2 cm high for women**. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **110-meter hurdle**s

 
 
• This race is open to both men and women.
 
• The hurdles are** 107 cm high in this race**. 
 
 
 
• In both races, the hurdles are placed at intervals across the running lanes.
 
• The runners must jump over the hurdles before reaching the finish line. 
 
• Another track and **field event that involves hurdles is the 3,000-meter steeplechase. **
 
• **This race includes 28 hurdles and seven w**ater jumps.
